content:
**Treated lining** is an underarmor armor mod in *Fallout 76*.

When applied to an underarmor, it increases two certain S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats based on the type of armor. It also increases Damage, Energy, and Radiation resistances.

| Underarmor type | | | | Effects | 
| Brotherhood of Steel | +6 | +4 | +2 | +1 Strength, +1 Endurance | 
| Casual | +2 | +2 | +3 | +1 Charisma, +1 Intelligence | 
| Enclave | +4 | +6 | +1 | +1 Strength, +1 Perception | 
| Marine | +4 | +4 | +4 | +1 Strength, +1 Endurance | 
| Raider | +4 | +2 | +0 | +1 Perception, +1 Agility | 
| Secret Service | +6 | +6 | +6 | +2 Strength, +2 Endurance | 
| Vault suit | +2 | +2 | +2 | +1 Endurance, +1 Luck | 

Crafting plans for underarmor modifications are often shared between multiple outfits, and unlocking the treated lining for a set will allow for any applicable underarmor to be modified.
